## Problem

What user problem would this solve? Describe the operator, agent, or workflow
without including private account or customer details.

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior and how it should interact with the
existing authorization, approval, audit, and replay boundaries.

## Alternatives and constraints

What alternatives did you consider? Note platform, provider, cost, or
configuration constraints that matter.

## Checklist

- [ ] This request does not require publishing credentials or customer data.
- [ ] This request does not assume production isolation or unsupported platform
      parity.
- [ ] I checked the existing documentation and issue list for duplicates.
